dossier.side_rule: LONG SNAPPER ROLE CONVENTION (t46u): rated as LS = nflverse roster position LS with 2025-26 special-teams snaps; matched by name/gsis id. THIN DATA, documented: PFF publishes no public LS grade (pff.com/grades/nfl/ls renders no table) and the FootballKickingStats reported-snap-error table is script-loaded; substitutes: aborted/bad snaps parsed from nflverse pbp descriptions on every FG/XP/punt snap, kicks/punts blocked on his snaps, FG make rate on his snaps, FootballKickingStats long-snapper unit points (credits the whole unit), coverage tackles on punts/kickoffs (pbp), accepted penalties, availability. Madden position is reference only.
